extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and toolbar.

extDescription.message: Reads your MyTANITA body-composition CSV export through your own logged-in session — no password, no API key — and hands it to the Kaiord editor.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

checking.description: Status verdict while the popup probes the session.

checkingCause.description: Status cause sentence shown while the probe runs.

connected.description: Status verdict when the MyTANITA session can reach the export.

connectedCause.message: Reading your body-composition export through your session.
connectedCause.description: Status cause sentence for the connected state.

notSignedIn.description: Status verdict when the MyTANITA session cannot reach the export.

notSignedInCause.message: Sign in at mytanita.eu once — the bridge reads your export from that session, no password stored.
notSignedInCause.description: Status cause sentence explaining how to establish a session.

sessionEnded.description: Status verdict when the MyTANITA session cannot reach the export AND an earlier popup open already recorded the outage. Distinct from notSignedIn, which is a setup step still pending rather than something that broke.

sessionEndedCause.message: Nothing has reached Kaiord since $date$. Sign in at mytanita.eu again and the bridge picks your export back up.
sessionEndedCause.description: Dated cause sentence for a session that worked and stopped. Names Kaiord's own intake, which the stored stamp establishes.

captionFeeds.description: Caption above the capability chips in the connected state.

captionWillFeed.description: Caption above the capability chips before the bridge is connected.

typeWeight.description: Capability chip for the Weight data type imported into Kaiord.

typeBodyComposition.description: Capability chip for the Body Composition data type imported into Kaiord.

manualFallback.message: Both currently come from manual entry.
manualFallback.description: Consequence line under the dashed chips: names where the two types are coming from while the bridge is not connected.

openEditor.description: Footer link that opens the Kaiord editor.

openTanitaPrimary.description: Primary footer link whenever the bridge is not connected. It is the fix — the session is established at MyTANITA, not in Kaiord — so it outranks the editor link.

setUpInKaiord.description: Secondary footer link while the bridge is not connected. Says set up rather than open: nothing from this source is in the editor yet.

openTanita.description: Secondary footer link opening mytanita.eu in a new tab.

refresh.description: Accessible label for the header refresh button.
